desc.en: Iron said to contain the power of magic. It's said to be fragments of fallen stars, and sold at a high price, but it doesn't look much different from ordinary rocks.
desc.ja: 魔法の力を含むと言われる鉄。降り注いだ星のかけらと言われ、一部では高額で取引されることもあるが、見た目は普通の石とそれほど変わらない

desc.en: Effect: Turns the healing item into a heal over time effect. It persists for 1 turn. Wait time after use is increased by 50％ in exchange.
desc.ja: 効果：回復アイテムの効果をタイム型にする。持続ターンは１ターン。その代わりに威力が２０％低下する
